seo.title: Tzu-Ling Hung | Percussionist & Composer
seo.description: Tzu-Ling Hung is a percussionist, chamber musician, and composer working across contemporary music, new work, and cross-disciplinary performance.

hero.image_alt: Abstract sound-art materials with water, stones, glass bowls, and xylophone wood
hero.tagline: Percussion, sound, and theatrical performance shaped by close listening and new possibility.

practice.statement: From solo percussion to staged multimedia work, Tzu-Ling treats performance as a place for curiosity, precision, and exchange.
practice.detail: Recent work includes HSS and tREeAL, a new vibraphone commission, and ongoing doctoral research at the University of North Texas.

about.heading: Expanding percussion through new music, collaboration, and performance.
paragraphs: Tzu-Ling Hung is a solo percussionist, chamber musician, and composer based in Denton, Texas and Pingtung, Taiwan. Her practice moves through classical and contemporary music, with a particular pull toward experimentation, theatricality, and underrepresented voices.

Recent projects include tREeAL, a multimedia performance tracing the space between direct acoustic interaction and electronic effects, and HSS, a collaboration with David Stout and Colin Stokes. As a composer, she draws from the sounds and perceptions of daily life.

As a soloist, Hung won first prize in the 2024 American Soloist International Music Competition and was a semi-finalist in the International Marimba Competition at Chapman University and the International Percussion Competition at Northwestern University. With the UNT Percussion Ensemble, she won the 2025 PAS International Percussion Ensemble Competition.

Hung is completing a Doctor of Musical Arts at the University of North Texas, where she is a Teaching Fellow. She holds a Master of Music and Performer Diploma from the Indiana University Jacobs School of Music, and a Bachelor of Fine Arts from the University of Taipei.

seo.title: 洪梓菱 | 打擊樂演奏家與作曲家
seo.description: 洪梓菱是旅美打擊樂演奏家、室內樂演奏家與作曲家，活躍於當代音樂、新作與跨域演出。

hero.image_alt: 水、石、玻璃器皿與木質敲擊素材構成的聲音藝術畫面
hero.eyebrow: 打擊樂演奏家 / 作曲家 / 當代音樂
hero.tagline: 從打擊、聲響與劇場性出發，透過細緻聆聽開展新的可能。

practice.statement: 從獨奏打擊樂到多媒體舞台作品，洪梓菱將表演視為好奇、精準與交流的場域。
practice.detail: 近期工作涵蓋 HSS、tREeAL、鐵琴獨奏新作委託，以及於北德州大學持續進行的博士研究。

about.heading: 以新音樂、跨域合作與舞台實踐拓展打擊樂的可能。
paragraphs: 旅美打擊樂演奏家、室內樂演奏家與作曲家洪梓菱，現於美國德州丹頓與台灣屏東兩地工作。她兼具古典與現代音樂的演奏實力，藝術實踐專注於發掘非主流與新興作品、探索劇場元素，並致力將個人的成長背景與生活觀察融入音樂。
近年跨域作品包括多媒體演出 tREeAL，探討傳統打擊樂器的實體原音、純電子軟體特效，以及兩者之間的混合空間；最新合作計畫 HSS 則與 David Stout 及 Colin Stokes 共同進行。作曲時，她常從日常生活中收集的聲音與感知出發。
作為獨奏家，洪梓菱獲得 2024 American Soloist International Music Competition 首獎，並入圍 Chapman University 國際馬林巴木琴大賽與 Northwestern University 國際打擊樂大賽準決賽。她亦隨北德州大學打擊樂團贏得 2025 PAS 國際打擊樂團大賽優勝。
洪梓菱現為北德州大學打擊樂演奏博士候選人，並兼任該校 Teaching Fellow。她於台北市立大學取得打擊樂演奏學士學位，並於印第安那大學積可斯音樂學院取得打擊樂演奏碩士學位與演奏家文憑。
